This be my plot for this season, and maize is what I will plant with some other crops mixed in, like cowpea or sorghum. I farm in the savanna here in the North East, and for maize you must put fertilizer if you want good harvest — without it the soil will not give you anything. I will buy a small amount of NPK and urea when the subsidy fertilizer comes, and I also have small manure from my few goats that I will spread before planting. I am young and strong so most of the work I will do myself with my wife, but for clearing the land at the start I may pay one or two people to help me finish quick.
